title: Hannah's Sacrifice: The Mother Who Gave Her Son Back to God
description:
Discover the powerful Bible story of Hannah, the childless woman whose heartfelt prayer changed everything. From the anguish of mockery by her rival Peninnah to the miraculous birth of Samuel, Hannah's journey is a testament to faith, desperation, and ultimately, surrender.

Read 1 Samuel 1-2 to follow Hannah's full story — from her silent tears at the tabernacle in Shiloh, through her vow to dedicate her son to the Lord, to the moment she brought little Samuel back to Eli with an offering of love and trust. Her story reminds us that true motherhood isn't about holding on, but about giving freely to God.

Scripture References: 1 Samuel 1:1-20, 1 Samuel 2:1-21
